'''August 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (19 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado on 19 August 2001. [[Josh Bader]] won it. It is known from Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2875">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-colorado-springs-a-howwible-day-8-19-01d2875/ colorado-springs-a-howwible-day-8-19-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 20 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-colorado-springs-a-howwible-day-8-19-01d2875/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Josh Bader]]
